jobs.description: Silver refresh of the 대지권등록 lane `land-right-registration` (root ADR-0169 ③): pick the newest vintage whose objects cover every 시도 the lane contract requires, read from the ZIP members measured beside the Bronze ledger, and, unless silver.land_right_registration already records it or a newer one (`unchanged`), export each object, stage it on a load branch, compare it with the table's current rows key bucket by key bucket and append to main only the changed keys' rows and a removal marker per vanished key (lane contract compare.content_columns; root ADR-0311, ADR-0318), and read it back (`changed`). Started when a source_sweep run lands new files, and daily as the fallback (root ADR-0171). One lane runs at a time: each takes the compose `spark` cap.

expected_outcome.basis: Bronze is collected daily (31 runs in 30 days), but a Silver release is cut far less often; measured 2026-11-11 from each unit's journal, 10-12..11-11 (read-only): no run said changed. A month and a day without one is a lane that stopped.
